visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraving depicting a group of people in a wooded area near a body of water. In the foreground, a soldier in a military uniform and tricorn hat sits on horseback, facing away from the viewer. To his right, another soldier in a similar uniform stands on the ground, looking toward the viewer. In the background, two women in period dresses and bonnets are mounted on horses. The style is that of a 19th-century book illustration.
